title: fsl_sub_mgh
description: Wrapper for job control system such as SGE, modified for compatibility with the PBS queueing system.

estimated_time.description: Estimated job length in minutes, used to auto-set queue name
estimated_time.title: Estimated job time

queue_name.description: Queue name. Possible values are 'verylong.q', 'long.q' and 'short.q'. Default is 'long.q'.
queue_name.title: Queue name

email_address.description: Email address to send notifications. Default is root@fmrib.ox.ac.uk.
email_address.title: Email address

hold_job.description: Job ID to place a hold on this task until completion.
hold_job.title: Hold job ID

task_file.description: Task file of commands to execute in parallel.
task_file.title: Task file

job_name.description: Specify job name as it will appear on the queue.
job_name.title: Job name

flags_in_scripts.description: Use flags embedded in scripts to set SGE queuing options.
flags_in_scripts.title: Flags in scripts flag
